DEFAULTS_TAKEN.condition: The publisher PDF and seven r2 figure files were on disk but UNDECLARED in the manifest, and every prior figure attestation rested on 726 px PMC CDN rasters.
DEFAULTS_TAKEN.default: Declare the publisher PDF and five derived native-resolution renders as source_artifacts with acquisition recipes, and read the adjudication panels from them.
DEFAULTS_TAKEN.why_safe: Additive. No existing artefact entry and no existing locator was edited; digests are verified by the strict validator; the renders live in the SHARED checkout's files/ tree, not the worktree, per the evidence-locality rule.
DEFAULTS_TAKEN.what_would_differ: Reading Figure 3B at 726 px would have left the flag's approximate values (~20 to ~90 days, ~80 percent) unmeasured and would not have surfaced that the wild-type control arm itself ends at 71-72 percent.

DEFAULTS_TAKEN.condition: Figure 7's aspect ratio did not match any image embedded in the publisher PDF (1.649 against 1.474), while the other seven matched to within 0.002.
DEFAULTS_TAKEN.default: Render page 11 at 400 dpi instead of extracting the embedded image, and record WHY in the artefact note.
DEFAULTS_TAKEN.why_safe: A page render is a superset of the embedded raster; the recipe names the extractor and its version, so the derivation replays.
DEFAULTS_TAKEN.what_would_differ: The extracted raster is 759x515 and carries the ECoG traces ALONE. Every number on panels B, C and E would have been absent, and the panel could have been written up as unreadable.

DEFAULTS_TAKEN.default: Add the two MISSING body quotations the relations should have pointed at - the Figure 3B caption statistics and the S7 gliosis sentence - rather than pointing the new panels at approximate neighbouring entries.

DEFAULTS_TAKEN.what_would_differ: Nothing scientific; the staged receipt would simply have been refused at append.

DEFAULTS_TAKEN.condition: The first commit of this task (TASK_ACK/TASK_CLAIM) was made before the attribution trailer was applied, and amending it would touch history.
DEFAULTS_TAKEN.default: Leave that commit as it stands, carry the trailer on every subsequent commit, and record the omission here.

DEFAULTS_TAKEN.condition: CLAIM 011's Status is `flagged for review`, not `consolidated baseline`, and no persisted verbatim locator is contradicted, corrected or replaced - so none of legend-locator-audit's four mandatory triggers fires on this narrowing.
DEFAULTS_TAKEN.default: Do not declare a mandatory audit that the rules do not require; RECOMMEND a voluntary one, state the reasoning in full so it can be disputed, and stop short of propagating in either case.
DEFAULTS_TAKEN.why_safe: Nothing is propagated. No registry file is touched, the proposal travels as a commit candidate, and producer-is-not-verifier is preserved because this actor does not certify its own adjudication. If the Orchestrator judges the trigger to fire, the audit runs before the candidate lands and nothing has to be undone.
